theater: 坎帕尼亞平原與維蘇威山麓

battle.name: 第一次薩莫奈戰爭
battle.theater: 坎帕尼亞平原與維蘇威山麓
battle.brief: 公元前343年，拉丁同盟聯同沃爾斯基、埃奎與赫爾尼基人攻打羅馬，薩莫奈人於前342年撕毀盟約馳援拉丁人，戰線自拉提烏姆推到坎帕尼亞平原。卡面希臘重步兵正是薩莫奈方陣的骨幹，羅馬則以縱隊梯次迎戰，於維蘇威山、特里法努與拉提利湖連勝，最終解散拉丁同盟。

kit.name: 希臘重步兵
kit.history: 方陣的重心不是個人，是互相遮蔽。盾牌接在一起時，一支軍隊的正面比一個人結實。

countries: 第一次薩莫奈戰爭是羅馬共和國對南義大利拉丁同盟及其盟邦的一場戰爭，公元前343年開打，前338年以拉丁同盟解散告終，薩莫奈部隊直接出現於前342、前340與前339年。羅馬一方是城邦國家的公民軍制：國民大會選出兩名執政官，任期一年，戰時各領一支執政官軍，每軍由兩個師組成，配屬騎兵與後備隊，另有元老院調度的緊急徵召；公元前342年局勢危急，羅馬首次設立握有最高指揮權的獨裁官，由奧盧斯·科爾涅利烏斯·卡爾武斯出任。聯盟一方是約三十個拉丁城邦組成的聯邦，加上沃爾斯基人、埃奎人、赫爾尼基人與薩莫奈聯盟五個部族；他們沒有常設統帥，戰前由各城代表推舉一名戰時最高統帥主持大局，薩莫奈的戰時主力則是格利烏斯·埃尼亞提烏斯率領的方陣部隊。羅馬與薩莫奈在公元前358年訂有為期二十五年的盟約，兩國在對付沃爾斯基人與埃奎人時互相倚重；前342年薩莫奈撕毀條約馳援拉丁人，使本役同時成為一次條約破裂後的懲罰性戰爭。
countriesEn: The First Samnite War was fought by the Roman Republic against a coalition made up of the Latin League and its allies in southern Italy. It began in 343 BC and ended in 338 BC with the dissolution of the Latin League, and Samnite troops appear directly in 342, 340 and 339 BC. On the Roman side stood the citizen army of a city state: the assembly of the comitia elected two consuls for a one-year term, and in wartime each commanded a consular army composed of two legions with attached cavalry and reserves, while the senate directed emergency levies. In 342 BC, with the situation turning critical, Rome created for the first time a dictator holding supreme command, and Aulus Cornelius Calvus was named to the office. On the opposing side was a federation of roughly thirty Latin towns, together with the Volsci, the Aequi, the Hernici and the Samnite confederacy of five tribes. They had no permanent commander-in-chief; before the campaign the delegates of the towns appointed a supreme commander for the duration of the war, and the Samnite contribution was the phalanx of heavy infantry led by Gellius Egnatius. Rome and Samnium had concluded a twenty-five year alliance in 358 BC, and the two had relied on each other against the Volsci and the Aequi; by tearing up that treaty in 342 BC the Samnites made this war also a punitive war fought over a broken agreement.
people: 留下姓名的關鍵人物集中在羅馬與薩莫奈兩端。薩莫奈統帥格利烏斯·埃尼亞提烏斯是全役最關鍵的敵方將領：前342年他率方陣部隊馳援拉丁人，在維蘇威山敗於羅馬後退往盧卡尼亞，前340年再度出戰又在特里法努兵敗，前339至前338年三度重現戰場。羅馬方面最著名者是德西烏斯·穆斯一門的自我奉獻：前342年執政官普布利烏斯·德西烏斯·穆斯在維蘇威山一役陣亡，以自身性命換取全軍反勝；其子普布利烏斯·德西烏斯·穆斯於前340年執政時同樣在特里法努戰死，父子兩代以同一種方式換取勝利。執政官圖盧斯·曼利烏斯·托爾夸圖斯在前343年與前340年兩度指揮軍隊，其子盧基烏斯·曼利烏斯·托爾夸圖斯亦陣亡於特里法努。前343年圖斯庫盧姆城門外的騎兵戰由馬爾庫斯·埃米利烏斯·萊皮杜斯指揮，沃爾斯基一方的將領維蒂烏斯於同年被斬。前338年拉提利湖之役則由執政官盧基烏斯·弗利烏斯·卡米盧斯率軍取勝。占卜官是另一批推動事件的人：他們要求把獨裁官的斧形標誌釘上卡比托利歐山，才允許設立終極指揮權，這套程序由祭司團與元老院主導，也招來平民議會的反對。
peopleEn: The names that survive from this war cluster on the Roman and the Samnite sides. The Samnite commander Gellius Egnatius was the most consequential enemy leader of the whole war: in 342 BC he brought his phalanx to the aid of the Latins, was beaten at Mount Vesuvius and withdrew into Lucania, returned to be defeated again at Trifanum in 340 BC, and reappeared on the field in 339 and 338 BC. The best known Romans are the Decii Mus and the ritual self-sacrifice of their house. Publius Decius Mus the elder, consul in 342 BC, fell at Mount Vesuvius, giving his own life to save the army; his son Publius Decius Mus, consul in 340 BC, died the same way at Trifanum, so that two generations met the same end on the same terms. The consul Titus Manlius Torquatus commanded armies in 343 and again in 340 BC, and his son Lucius Manlius Torquatus also fell at Trifanum. The Roman cavalry action outside the Tusculan Gate in 343 BC was led by Marcus Aemilius Lepidus, while the Volscian commander Vettius was killed in the same year. The victory at the Lake Regillus in 338 BC was won under the consul Publius Furius Camillus. Another group of decisive actors were the augurs, who demanded that the axe emblem of the dictatorship be nailed to the Capitol before supreme command could be created; that procedure was driven by the priestly colleges and the senate, and it drew resistance in the popular assembly.
kits: 卡面這件希臘重步兵正好對應本役交戰雙方共有的地中海重裝步兵傳統，但兩邊的用法不同。薩莫奈的重步兵幾乎照搬希臘系統：大型橢圓形盾牌（後來被羅馬人稱為薩莫奈盾並改稱 scutum）、有冠青銅頭盔、亞麻束腰甲、脛甲，以及一支約兩公尺長的標槍，配以可投擲的短矛；波利比烏斯在《歷史》第六卷明確記載薩莫奈的裝備與陣式都與希臘人相同，薩莫奈軍在作戰中排成方陣，這正是卡面立繪所呈現的樣子。羅馬一方則已在公元前499年之後放棄方陣，改用縱隊編成的軍團梯次：輕裝散兵以投槍在前騷擾，主戰首列裝備仍接近重步兵，持大橢圓盾、短劍與加重的投槍，後方長槍兵則以長矛待命。同一套重裝步兵技術，在羅馬被收進分隊的梯次裡，在薩莫奈卻組成整個正面。投射與載具的差異同樣重要：拉丁聯盟的騎兵數量與經驗都用於襲擾和掩護兩翼，羅馬騎兵則多為有產的公民自備馬匹；野營靠工匠挖掘帶壕溝的營寨，糧食由羅馬城的穀倉與坎帕尼亞的產糧區供應，薩莫奈的補給線要翻越阿布魯佐與薩莫奈山地的山口。
kitsEn: The hoplite on the card maps onto a heavy infantry tradition shared by both sides of this war, but the two put it to different use. Samnite heavy infantry borrowed the Greek system almost wholesale: a large oval shield, later called by the Romans the Samnite shield and used as the scutum, a crested bronze helmet, a linen cuirass, greaves, and a spear about two metres long, together with throwable javelins. Polybius states explicitly in the sixth book of his Histories that the Samnite equipment and array were the same as the Greek, and the Samnite army fought in phalanx, which is exactly what the card shows. The Romans, by contrast, had abandoned the phalanx after 499 BC and fought in a manipular legion organised in successive lines: light-armed skirmishers harassed the front with javelins, the main battle line was armed much like hoplites, carrying the large oval scutum, a short sword and a weighted pilum, while long spear troops waited at the rear. The same heavy infantry technology therefore survives on the Roman side, but folded into the levels of a maniple, while for the Samnites it made up the entire front. Differences in missiles and in transport mattered too: the Latins used their cavalry numbers and experience for harassment and to cover the flanks, Roman knights were citizens who served with horses of their own, field camps were dug as ditched lines by engineers, and grain came from the granaries of the city and the producing districts of Campania, while the Samnite supply line had to cross the passes of the Abruzzo and of Samnium.
tactics: 兩種典型陣形在拉提烏姆與坎帕尼亞的戰場上正面碰撞。薩莫奈與拉丁聯盟的方陣以深度換取正面強度：盾牌相接、矛尖越過前排肩頭，縱深可達十餘排，士氣全靠整體不散。前342年維蘇威山一役，聯軍佔據火山坡地居高臨下，羅馬軍以執政官兩翼包抄，正面用縱隊輪番接戰，並以一次佯退把追來的敵軍拉入低地，從側面撕開方陣。前340年特里法努，羅馬列成三段縱隊，先以散兵與首列進攻，待方陣消耗、陣線鬆動，再讓長槍兵頂上缺口，方陣正面隨即崩潰，聯盟軍全軍潰散。前338年拉提利湖之役，羅馬利用湖岸地形，正面先佯敗，敵軍左翼追擊使陣線拉長，羅馬騎兵與後備縱隊隨即打其側翼。撤退與追擊的安排同樣關鍵：羅馬常在敵營與盟軍營寨之間切斷各城分批到援，逐次擊破；薩莫奈統帥屢次丟下營地退往盧卡尼亞，說明其補給線始終受制於羅馬對坎帕尼亞道路與城邑的逐步控制。營地紀律、哨戒與渡河次序也常常決定成敗；城邦軍隊的動員依賴部落輪番徵召，時間往往不夠一次全軍出動，聯盟軍的協同因此比單一軍隊更脆弱。
tacticsEn: Two characteristic formations collided on the fields of Latium and Campania. The Samnite and Latin phalanx bought frontage strength with depth: shields touching, spear points passing over the shoulders of the rank in front, files ten or more ranks deep, and the cohesion of the whole depending on no one man breaking. At Mount Vesuvius in 342 BC the coalition held the slopes of the volcano above the plain, and the Romans answered by working both flanks, feeding their manipular lines into the assault in relays, and drawing the enemy down with a feigned retreat so that the phalanx could be opened from the side. At Trifanum in 340 BC the Romans drew up in three successive lines, let the skirmishers and the main line engage first, and brought the long spear troops forward to plug the gaps as the phalanx wore down and its front broke, which is when the coalition line collapsed altogether. At the Lake Regillus in 338 BC the Romans used the ground along the shore of the lake, offered a feigned defeat on the front, and when the enemy left wing pursued and stretched its order, struck it with the cavalry and the reserve lines. Withdrawal and pursuit were decisive in their own right: the Romans repeatedly cut the piecemeal reinforcements of the allied cities apart and defeated them in detail, and the Samnite commander repeatedly abandoned his camp for Lucania, a sign that his supply line was always at the mercy of Roman control of the roads and towns of Campania. Camp discipline, picketing and the order in which rivers were forded decided as much as the fighting itself. Because the mobilisation of a citizen army depended on tribal levies called out in turn, the time available for bringing the whole army together was often too short, and that made the coalition far more fragile than any single army.
data: 可核對的數字大致集中在編制與年表兩方面。戰爭自公元前343年打到前338年，前後約六年，薩莫奈方陣直接參與的主要是前342、前340、前339與前338四個年度。羅馬的人力基礎是公元前六世紀末的塞爾維烏斯普查改革：每個部落出四千人步兵與四百名騎兵，全城三十五個部落，理論總額為十四萬步兵與一萬四千騎兵；波利比烏斯則記錄當時羅馬實際能投入作戰的兵力約八萬步兵與六千騎兵，這是編制上限而非每次出動的實數。一支執政官軍約九千步兵與六百騎兵，兩名執政官各領一支，故大戰役的常規出動約一萬八千步兵與一千二百騎兵，另加臨時徵召的輔助部隊。步兵分三級，輕裝散兵、主戰首列與長槍後備，每級在前線的寬度一般以約兩百人計算。戰場距離也可推算：拉提利湖與圖斯庫盧姆距羅馬城約二十餘公里，卡普阿在坎帕尼亞平原上，距羅馬約二百公里，前線沿拉提納大道與阿庇亞大道推進，維蘇威火山在卡普阿西北不遠，糧食產區就在營寨後方供應。傷亡與俘虜的精確數字在古代記載中出入甚大，不能照單全收；可以確定的是前341年聯盟軍在拉提烏姆境內再度潰敗，兩名沃爾斯基首領被羅馬軍俘獲，前342年維蘇威山之役聯盟全營被羅馬接管，薩莫奈統帥則帶走部分部眾退往盧卡尼亞。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked cluster around organisation and chronology. The war ran from 343 to 338 BC, about six years, and the Samnite phalanx fought directly in the campaign years 342, 340, 339 and 338. The Roman manpower base was the Servian census reform of the late sixth century BC: each of the thirty five tribes furnished 4,000 foot and 400 horse, giving a theoretical total of 140,000 infantry and 14,000 cavalry, while Polybius records that Rome could actually put about 80,000 foot and 6,000 horse in the field, an authorised ceiling rather than the number mustered for any single battle. A consular army came to about 9,000 infantry and 600 cavalry, so the usual force in a major battle was some 18,000 foot and 1,200 horse from the two consular armies, together with levies raised as auxiliaries. The infantry was graded in three levels, light skirmishers, the main battle line and the long spear reserve, and each level was normally deployed about two hundred men wide on the front. Distances are recoverable as well: the Lake Regillus and Tusculum lie a little over twenty kilometres from the city of Rome, Capua stands in the plain of Campania some two hundred kilometres away, the line of advance followed the Via Latina and the Via Appia, Mount Vesuvius lay not far to the north west of Capua, and the grain lands of the plain lay behind the Roman camps to feed them. Precise loss and prisoner figures in the ancient accounts vary widely and cannot be taken at face value. What can be said with confidence is that a coalition army was broken and heavily taken prisoner in Latium in 341 BC, that the whole camp of the coalition was taken over by the Romans at Mount Vesuvius in 342 BC, and that the Samnite commander managed to lead part of his men away into Lucania.
cause: 開戰的直接原因是拉丁同盟對羅馬在拉提烏姆的膨脹感到恐懼。經過塞爾維烏斯改革與此前對沃爾斯基人、埃奎人的數次勝利，羅馬在台伯河下游建立了其他拉丁城邦無法接受的影響力，並把勢力伸入阿爾巴山與奧爾布魯斯山，把聯盟各城逐步逼入附庸地位。前343年聯盟方面先發制人，聯軍攻下羅馬在富奇涅的野戰營寨，戰爭由拉提烏姆外圍一路打到坎帕尼亞。薩莫奈人介入有明確的條約背景：公元前358年羅馬與薩莫奈訂立為期二十五年的盟約，兩國在對沃爾斯基人與埃奎人的戰爭中互相倚重；但羅馬在拉提烏姆取勝後的擴張正逐步威脅薩莫奈聯盟在坎帕尼亞的商路與控制區，於是薩莫奈在前342年撕毀條約，率方陣部隊馳援拉丁人，把一場聯盟防禦戰變成條約破裂後的正面衝突。羅馬內部同樣有自己的觸發點：城內傳染病削弱了軍隊整備，元老院與執政官需要非常集權的指揮權，而聯盟的進攻恰好提供了要求設立獨裁官的政治契機。
causeEn: The immediate reason for the war was the fear of the Latin League that Roman expansion in Latium would go unchecked. After the Servian reform and earlier victories over the Volsci and the Aequi, Rome had built up an influence in the lower Tiber valley that the other Latin towns could not accept, pushing its influence up into the Alban hills and towards the Abruzzo and drawing the allied towns of the league one by one into a dependent position. In 343 BC the coalition struck first and took the Roman field camp at Fucine, and the war was fought from the edges of Latium all the way into Campania. The Samnite intervention had a documented treaty background: in 358 BC Rome and Samnium concluded an alliance for twenty-five years, and the two had relied on each other in the wars against the Volsci and the Aequi, but the Roman advance after its victories in Latium was beginning to threaten the Samnite league's control of the trade routes and districts of Campania. So in 342 BC the Samnites tore up the treaty and brought their phalanx to the aid of the Latins, turning a war of league self defence into a direct confrontation over a broken oath. There was also a Roman trigger: disease inside the city wore down the readiness of the army, the senate and the consuls needed a single concentrated command, and the coalition attack provided the political opening for creating a dictator.
impact: 第一次薩莫奈戰爭的直接結果，是拉丁同盟在政治上被解散，羅馬由一個拉丁城邦變成義大利中部的主導者。原同盟三十餘城邦在拉提利湖之役後各自與羅馬結盟，羅馬以同盟領袖的身分接管對外用兵與仲裁權，同時保留各城的內政自治；這種解散聯盟而由羅馬取代的模式在此後數十年裡不斷重演，阿爾巴山、埃奎、沃爾斯基與赫爾尼基的地區先後被納入同一框架。對薩莫奈聯盟而言，這是一場輸得起的敗仗：前342至前338年的失敗迫使薩莫奈勢力退出拉提烏姆與坎帕尼亞的公開對抗，退回南阿平寧山區，但聯盟的組織與步兵傳統毫髮無傷，因此十年後前327年，薩莫奈人趁羅馬主力在薩莫奈境內而鄰邦空虛時再度開戰，把戰火反向燒到坎帕尼亞，進而引出前280年的皮洛士戰爭與第三次薩莫奈戰爭。制度層面的後果同樣長遠：公元前342年設立的第一位獨裁官，連同占卜官要求的斧釘儀式，確立了羅馬在危機中集中指揮權的先例；而兩役中反覆出現的自我奉獻，把將軍以身殉軍的行為寫進羅馬的軍隊信仰，成為此後數百年共和國將領的標準動作之一。軍事技術上，縱隊梯次在正面強度上勝過希臘式方陣這一判斷，也在這幾年裡被反覆驗證，成為羅馬此後面對希臘化世界軍隊的基本自信來源。
impactEn: The immediate result of the First Samnite War was the political dissolution of the Latin League and the transformation of Rome from one Latin town into the dominant power of central Italy. The thirty-odd towns of the old league, after the Lake Regillus, made separate alliances with Rome, which took over the conduct of foreign affairs and the power of arbitration while leaving each city its internal autonomy; that pattern of dissolving a league and replacing it with Roman primacy was repeated for decades afterwards, as the Alban hills, the Aequi, the Volsci and the Hernici were drawn one by one into the same framework. For the Samnite league this was a defeat it could afford: the defeats of 342 to 338 BC drove Samnite power out of open confrontation in Latium and Campania and back into the southern Apennines, but the organisation of the league and its infantry tradition were untouched, so that ten years later, in 327 BC, the Samnites struck again while the Roman main force was inside Samnium and the neighbouring towns were empty, carried the war back into Campania, and so set off the Pyrrhic war of 280 BC and the Third Samnite War. The institutional consequences are equally long lived: the first dictator, created in 342 BC, together with the rite of the clavus demanded by the augurs, established the precedent of concentrating command in a crisis, and the devotio that appears again and again in this war wrote into Roman military belief the image of the general who gives his life to save the army, which remained a standard of conduct for Roman commanders for centuries afterwards. On the technical side, the judgement that the manipular order outmatched the Greek phalanx in frontage strength was confirmed again and again in these years, and became one of the foundations of Roman confidence when it came to confront the armies of the Hellenistic world.
result: 以戰役序列來看，羅馬在前343年的圖斯庫盧姆城門騎兵戰、前342年的維蘇威山之戰、前340年的特里法努之戰、前339年拉提烏姆境內的追擊戰與前338年的拉提利湖之戰中接連取勝，聯盟方面沒有取得任何一次決定性勝利。前342年維蘇威山一役，聯軍營寨被羅馬接管，薩莫奈統帥格利烏斯·埃尼亞提烏斯退往盧卡尼亞；前340年特里法努，薩莫奈方陣在正面崩潰，聯盟軍被大量俘獲，薩莫奈人再次退回山區；前339年聯盟傾盡兵力再戰再敗；前338年拉提利湖一役後，拉丁、埃奎、沃爾斯基與赫爾尼基相繼求和，拉丁同盟在法律與組織上被解散，羅馬接管聯盟，成為拉丁世界唯一的軍事召集者。薩莫奈聯盟則沒有被征服：他們的方陣部隊、盟約網絡與山區根據地都還在，撤退是有秩序的而非崩潰，前327年第二次薩莫奈戰爭的爆發，說明第一次薩莫奈戰爭終結的只是羅馬在拉提烏姆的霸權，而不是薩莫奈人的戰鬥意志。卡面上這件希臘重步兵在這一役中的位置因此很明確：它象徵的方陣是薩莫奈聯盟的骨幹，卻在羅馬縱隊梯次面前失去勝算；同一套重裝步兵技術，在兩邊的編制裡得到了完全不同的命運。
resultEn: Campaign by campaign, Rome won at the cavalry fight outside the Tusculan Gate in 343 BC, at Mount Vesuvius in 342, at Trifanum in 340, in the pursuit in Latium in 339, and at the Lake Regillus in 338; the coalition won nothing decisive. At Mount Vesuvius in 342 BC the camp of the coalition was taken over by the Romans, and the Samnite commander Gellius Egnatius withdrew into Lucania. At Trifanum in 340 BC the Samnite phalanx broke on the front, a large part of the coalition was taken prisoner, and the Samnites fell back to the mountains once more. The coalition made one more effort in 339 BC and was beaten again, and after the Lake Regillus in 338 BC the Latins, the Aequi, the Volsci and the Hernici sued for peace in turn: the Latin League was dissolved in law and in organisation, and Rome took over the alliance as the only summoner of military power in the Latin world. The Samnite league was not conquered. Its phalanx troops, its network of alliances and its mountain bases all remained, and the withdrawal was an ordered retreat rather than a collapse, as the outbreak of the Second Samnite War in 327 BC showed. What the First Samnite War ended was Roman hegemony in Latium, not Samnite will to fight. The position of the hoplite on the card is therefore clear: the phalanx it stands for was the backbone of the Samnite league, and it lost its chance against the Roman manipular lines. The same heavy infantry technology met completely different fates in the two command systems.
